race.comment: THE LITTLE GENERAL (6) scored a game win first-up at Hawkesbury then started favourite and led again here a fortnight ago over this trip but looked in bother a fair way out and was beaten four lengths. Very little quality in this line-up so with that extra run under the belt he can turn things around. FAMOSO (7) has been strong through the line in his two runs this prep, both on the Canberra Acton track. Yet to prove himself in town but won't get too many softer targets than this. Strong contender at the third run back. HARRY'S EVIDENCE (4) is back after a three-month spell. Popular in betting through last prep but tended to be hot and cold. Trialled well recently so he looks ready for a bright return. Veteran KING GUTHO (3) can bob up on his return to midweek company. GAMBLER (2) is fitter for two runs back from a spell and from the inside gate looms as a genuine hope.
